<div class="amr-policy"><div class="policy-hero"><div class="policy-title" role="heading" aria-level="1">Terms & Conditions</div><p>For courses, statistical consultations, and services.</p></div><p class="policy-date">Last updated: 10 September 2026</p>
<div class="policy-section">
<div class="policy-heading" role="heading" aria-level="2">Services covered</div>
<p>AMRBiostats provides free learning resources, paid courses, training, statistical consultation, analysis, and R programming support. These terms apply to those services. A general enquiry does not commit you to a purchase.</p>
</div>
<div class="policy-section">
<div class="policy-heading" role="heading" aria-level="2">Scope, prices & additional work</div>
<p>The course description or quotation sets out the service, deliverables, delivery arrangements, and total price. Prices for customers in Egypt are stated in <strong>Egyptian pounds (EGP)</strong>, including applicable taxes and charges. Prices in other currencies may also be displayed for customers outside Egypt.</p>
<p>For custom work, we review your requirements and send a quotation. The scope and cost are agreed before payment or work begins. New research questions, substantially revised datasets, additional analyses, or revisions outside the agreed scope may require a revised quotation. Any additional fee and change to the delivery date will be agreed with you before the extra work is undertaken.</p>
</div>
<div class="policy-section">
<div class="policy-heading" role="heading" aria-level="2">Payment & confirmation</div>
<p>Use the payment methods and instructions provided for your booking. Payment is confirmed after receipt is verified through the relevant payment provider or receiving account. Keep your payment or booking reference for enquiries.</p>
<p>Where an external payment provider is used, enter card details only through its payment process. Do not send payment-card details by email or message. Verified duplicate or excess payments are handled under the <a href="refund.html">Refund &amp; Cancellation Policy</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="policy-section">
<div class="policy-heading" role="heading" aria-level="2">Courses, appointments & delivery</div>
<p>Course format, dates, access arrangements, and any computer or software requirements are explained before purchase. Participants are responsible for having the equipment, internet connection, and software needed to attend. Consultation bookings are confirmed once availability is agreed.</p>
<p>Project delivery dates depend on timely receipt of the required data, information, and responses. If these are delayed or the agreed scope changes, we will discuss any necessary adjustment to the delivery date. If we cancel or materially change an agreed service, the options available are explained in our <a href="refund.html">Refund &amp; Cancellation Policy</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="policy-section">
<div class="policy-heading" role="heading" aria-level="2">Research responsibilities & accuracy</div>
<p>You are responsible for the accuracy and completeness of the data and study information you provide, permission to share it, and any required research or ethics approvals. Data-quality or study-design issues may require clarification before analysis proceeds.</p>
<p>Analyses are selected to address the agreed question and the available data. We do not guarantee statistically significant findings, support for a hypothesis, publication acceptance, or approval by an institution or reviewer. Genuine errors within the agreed work will be corrected without an additional fee.</p>
<p>You remain responsible for the final conclusions and content of your manuscript, thesis, or report, including how the statistical findings are used. This does not remove our responsibility for the accuracy of the statistical work we provide.</p>
</div>
<div class="policy-section">
<div class="policy-heading" role="heading" aria-level="2">Professional purpose & research integrity</div>
<p>Our services support education, research, and statistical analysis. They do not replace medical or other regulated professional advice. Decisions about individual patient care remain the responsibility of the appropriately qualified healthcare professional.</p>
<p>We do not fabricate data, falsify findings, or manipulate analyses to obtain a preferred result. Clients are responsible for appropriate acknowledgement and authorship decisions, following the requirements of their institution, funder, or journal.</p>
</div>
<div class="policy-section">
<div class="policy-heading" role="heading" aria-level="2">Materials & confidentiality</div>
<p>Paid learning materials are for the purchaser’s personal educational use unless another licence is stated. Do not sell, share, or publicly redistribute them without permission. These restrictions do not replace the stated open licence on freely published materials.</p>
<p>Client data and unpublished project information are treated as confidential. Access or disclosure is limited to what is needed to provide the agreed service, what you authorize, or what the law requires. Research data remains yours.</p>
<p>Remove unnecessary personal identifiers before sharing research data. Please do not include payment-card details or identifiable participant data in an initial enquiry.</p>
</div>
<div class="policy-section">
<div class="policy-heading" role="heading" aria-level="2">Cancellations, rights & changes</div>
<p>Read the <a href="refund.html">Refund &amp; Cancellation Policy</a> alongside these terms before purchasing. It explains cancellation, rescheduling, service problems, and refunds.</p>
<p>Updates apply to future purchases. The terms and agreed quotation applicable when you purchase remain the reference for that booking, subject to mandatory legal requirements.</p>
</div>
